message: スウィーツ讃歌

name: Synn
message: 「Even though exams are coming up, why am I even here……」
And on top of that, I've got crepes in both hands.
For the record, one's chocolate banana and the other's custard whipped cream. Piping hot.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't sweat the small stuff!」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But still…… the promise of getting treated to cake was just too tempting!」
Chomp. Delicious!　Delicious, and yet!

name: Paqy
message: 「Just give up and enjoy it」

name: Synn
message: 「B-B-But still!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun. If you keep worrying like that, your crepes are gonna stop tasting good~」

name: Yumil
message: 「Hafu. Munch chomp nom nom, so good. Really good」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look at Yumil!　Not a single worry in sight!」

name: Synn
message: 「True……」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, exams!　Actually, are you guys even gonna be okay for exams?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even a raging fire ain't scary if we all jump in together」

name: Synn
message: 「That's just an illusion!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm a pacifist, you know~. Non-violence, non-resistance, civil disobedience~. I'm sticking to civil disobedience against exams~」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, if you're fine with your winter break getting ruined, go right ahead」

name: Yumil
message: 「It'll work out somehow」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it definitely won't work out」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're such a buzzkill, Synn」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I don't wanna face reality in a game~」

name: Synn
message: 「Like I said, this isn't a game, it's reality」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yeah, well, that's only 'cause you're smart, Senpai. Me, I've never gotten anything other than failing grades」

name: Yumil
message: 「Over break, I usually show up about half the time. Well, that's just normal for me」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What a big shot...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「A real big shot~」
Amidst the silence, I slowly finished eating the crepes in both of my hands.

name: Synn
message: 「...I get it. If you're that prepared for the consequences, I won't say a word」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yessir」

name: Synn
message: 「If Nanaka and Sacchin are this enlightened too, I won't say anything either, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sorry. My bad for dragging you along today too, Synn!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Can't be helped~ I'll study starting tomorrow~」
Everyone seemed to understand.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Which means today, we eat!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Next stop, GO to Chocolat l'Or!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though exams are coming up, why am I even here……」
And on top of that, there are two sweets right in front of me.
Incidentally, an almond gateau chocolat and a raspberry tiramisu.

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're looping, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But still, the promise of treating me to cake was just too tempting!」
Chomp. So good! It's good enough to make me cry!
It's delicious, and yet!

name: Paqy
message: 「Just give up already and enjoy it. You ended up letting them treat you to two of 'em anyway, didn't ya?」

name: Synn
message: 「B-B-But still! It's so good! I hate how good this is! So good!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun. If you keep worrying like that, the sweets won't taste as good~」

name: Yumil
message: 「Munch, munch... This is good, sir. Really good, sir」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look at Yumil!　Not a single worry in sight!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If only we could reach that level of enlightenment~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, seriously~」

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me doesn't have tests either」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I might wanna be like Paqy-kun too~」

name: Paqy
message: 「My situation ain't really somethin' to be jealous of, though」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I threw away a bunch of stuff I shouldn't have thrown away」

name: Synn
message: 「Like your shame?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's harsh」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I got it~, it's your conscience~!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, that's just cruel」

name: Yumil
message: 「Hafuu. Ate, ate, and ate some more-ssu」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Thanks for the meal~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's wrap things up for today」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sparkle~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan! Next time we come here, you said you'd eat Chocolat's Special Choco-Melon Parfait, right~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aah. That's right! I forgot!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yumil and I are heading home a step ahead~, so Nana-chan's gonna stay and eat it~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, even I'm already」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Operation commence~. It's the AN Project~!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-Now!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ay-En Project?」

name: Yumil
message: 「I see, we'll leave the rest to the two young'uns-ssu」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey, wait a sec\s01」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun. Keep Nana-chan company till the very end, okay」

name: Yumil
message: 「Here's my share of the bill. I already put the order in for you guys. Later!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ehhh?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Farewell~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Th-This is...」

name: Synn
message: 「The Special Chocolate Melon Parfait...」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-This melon... It has netting on it, so it's an Andes melon, right...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, it's a muskmelon.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-This is the legendary muskmelon!」
That thing always displayed in a corner of the supermarket or greengrocer with a price tag that makes your head spin!
Seeing the muskmelon jammed into the cup, rind and all, is a magnificent sight.
The slightly yellowish ice cream supporting it is like a snowy mountain.
And drizzled around it like delicate lacework is the chocolate.

name: Synn
message: 「J-Just how much does this cost?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll just say you're better off not asking.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, I won't ask.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um, well... let's see...」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me the price!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, not that, well, this thing is pretty big, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, yeah, it is.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't think I can... y-you know... finish it all by myself.」

name: Synn
message: 「Really?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Really!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, well... um... you know...」

name: Synn
message: 「*Gulp*」
For some reason, even though I was just watching Nanaka, I swallowed hard.
What is this tension?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, you see... um... so... it'd be a waste to leave any behind, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... I guess so」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, you know. Ahh, ugh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, whatever, here goes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eat it with me!」
Calm down, me! What am I getting so nervous about?
Nanaka can't eat all of it, and leaving leftovers would be a waste.
So she's giving some to me too.
Okay, okay. No problem at all.

name: Synn
message: 「G-Got it. I'll eat some」
Why am I stammering?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haaaaahhh... thank goodness...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, um, when I say thank goodness, it's just because I can't eat it all by myself, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I know that」

name: Nanaka
message: 「G-Good then... Well, right away」
Nanaka's spoon moved terribly slowly, scooping out a corner of the giant snowy mountain.
The spoon holding the slightly yellowish ice cream is pointed toward me.

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um... it's facing the wrong way?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's fine like this!」

name: Synn
message: 「But you can't eat it unless you point it toward yourself?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because I'm not the one eating this!」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Then who is!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who else would it be besides you!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「S-S-So! Open your mouth!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahhhhhhh. I'm saying I'll feed you and go 'say ahh,' so open your mouth!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huff, huff... wheeze, wheeze... I said it... I actually went and said it...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whaaaaaaaat!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't 'whaaat' me! All you gotta do is open your mouth wide like an oxygen-starved goldfish! Don't think!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, wait, I really don't think that's a good idea!? I'm not a little kid!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Big or small, who cares about that!」

name: Synn
message: 「I do!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, it's fine! Just open your mouth a liiittle bit! It'll be over in a second! It won't hurt!」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you a dentist?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Unlike a dentist, mine is, ahhhhhh, super sweet! Gobble it right up!」
A spoon carrying melting ice cream inches steadily closer and closer!

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, wait a second, Nanaka! Just drink some water and calm down!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like I could pull this off if I were calm!」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's why you need to calm down! Paqy, stop her!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not stopping her is the mercy of a warrior, man」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah, I'm pushing my maidenly heart to MAX output just to do this! So open your mouth already!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nanaka!? Your eyes are bloodshot!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't sweat an eye or two! E-Everything's a learning experience!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grr, open up! Open wide, you bastard!」

name: Synn
message: 「Noooooo」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What'd you say?! Are you telling me you can't do 'say ahh' if it's with me?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「He'd totally do it if it were Ria-chan feeding him, man」
Ria-senpai, to me...

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Please, open your mouth for me, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai, um, well, I...!」

name: Ria
message: 「Li-sten-to-your-big-sis-ter. Okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes! Whoa?!」
Leaning forward with all her might, the tip of the spoon Nanaka is holding is right now trying to pry open my lips?!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are you standing up just to run away!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're scary right now, Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up! If you just take one bite, I'll show you the ultimate smile!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, hearing that while you've got those bloodshot eyes has zero persuasion!」
I'm steadily getting backed into a corner.
A wall behind me! Am I in a pinch?!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah, shut up! Take my 'say ahh'!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get it, but no way!」
Thud--something hard hit my back.
The wall already?!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heh heh heh. You can't run anymore!」
W-Why is this happening?! We're only supposed to be eating a parfait together, so why am I in such a huge pinch?
I've gotta get out of this somehow!!

name: Synn
message: 「L-Look! If you don't quiet down! Everyone's staring!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Umm...」
With awkward movements, Nanaka brought the spoon to her own mouth.

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's good」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's great」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha」
Taking her wallet out of her pocket, Nanaka lined up bills and coins on the table,

name: Nanaka
message: 「This should be the exact amount, so... I-I'll leave the rest to you!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've gotta study for tests! Later!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaat?! H-Hey, wait up, Nanaka!」
She took off...

name: Paqy
message: 「So close. Your loser circuits really are running at full blast, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「P-Paqy, what are you doing?」

name: Paqy
message: 「This Special Choco-Melon Parfait thing was crazy good.」
It was empty.

name: Paqy
message: 「You should've eaten the one with the spoon right next to it, Lord Synn--」
